# Third-party assets

This folder contains vendored (locally hosted) third-party libraries to avoid
CDN dependency on GitHub Pages (improves reliability and speed for visitors).

- Bootstrap 4.6.0 (`vendor/bootstrap/`)
  - https://getbootstrap.com/
  - License: MIT
- marked 15.x (`vendor/marked/`)
  - https://marked.js.org/
  - License: MIT
